{{Top|leg}}{{Quote|Want to see the final outcome, old clockwork? Well, you’re going to, anyway. Here we go. Well, that’s not too bad, after all. It’s the Universe.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}'''The Universe''' was a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card exclusive to the [[Centran sabacc/Legends|Centran]] variant of the game. As a face card, it only appeared once in the deck. In addition to being played, the card carried meaning in cartomancy. When drawn for the position representing the final outcome, The Universe implied that the subject would have a shot at everything they want to do and accomplish.<ref name="Lando" />

*''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'' {{1st}}
